does: The per-frame step of the client's character creation that keeps a dummy in step with its definition. For a dummy definition entity it takes ecl::character_creation::DummyDefinitionComponent, and from the dummy it names the target visual and ecl::character_creation::DummyComponent; when the definition's ChangeId differs from the dummy's it copies it and refills the target visual (FillTargetVisualComponent, or a reset when the definition has no race); when ChangeId2 differs it copies it and calls FillTargetVisualComponentColorsAndMaterials with the definition's Visual at +0xC8. A mod that writes a look into the dummy definition and moves ChangeId2 gets the dummy redrawn by this step.

evidence.says: the two comparisons and copies between DummyComponent.ChangeId / ChangeId2 and +0x8 / +0xC of the definition, each followed by its fill call

a count-only probe shows 285 calls in nine seconds, all from bg3_dx11.exe+0x202E72C, while a change-appearance session stands; after a client write of ChangeId2 + 1 the dummy's counter reads the new value and the colours-and-materials fill is called once from inside this function

questions.ask: the game's own name: the caller bg3_dx11.exe+0x202E72C belongs to a system of ecl::character_creation whose update walks the dummy definitions; the macOS build's symbols name it
